title: you are not goliath.
author: Malachi Versus
description:
"you are not goliath" is a game retelling instances of cultural genocide, made for a university assignment. In it, the reader recounts historical events, culminating in an attempt to challenge the notion that cultural destruction is not sufficient for the Convention and to highlight the mental and psychological harm it causes.

Content warning: this work contains themes of body and psychological horror, surrealism, dreams/nightmares, and references to historical atrocities. It recounts the destruction of the National and University Library of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Stolen Generations.

Though all characters are fictional and the work contains no names or images of deceased peoples, it is told through a first person point of view and may be distressing. As the author and artist, I would like to pay my respects to the First Nations Peoples of Australia. Sovereignty was never ceded.
